message:
Command `cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json <<'EOF'
[{"step":1,"file":"tests/fuzz/fuzz_decompress_frame.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":21,"var":"data,size","code":"blosc2_schunk_from_buffer((uint8_t *) data, size, false)","note":"The input bytes are parsed directly as a contiguous frame, so a crafted .b2frame payload can control header, offsets, and chunk layout."},{"step":2,"file":"blosc/frame.c","function":"get_header_info","line":365,"var":"framep","code":"parse frame header fields including frame_len, nbytes, cbytes, blocksize, chunksize, and frame type","note":"Header parsing derives the logical frame and chunk counts from attacker-controlled bytes before any chunk access happens."},{"step":3,"file":"blosc/frame.c","function":"get_coffsets","line":964,"var":"coffsets","code":"get_coffsets(frame, header_len, cbytes, &off_cbytes)","note":"The frame trailer is interpreted as a compressed offset table that determines where each chunk lives."},{"step":4,"file":"blosc/frame.c","function":"get_coffset","line":1706,"var":"offset","code":"blosc2_getitem(coffsets, off_cbytes, nchunk, 1, offset, (int32_t)sizeof(int64_t))","note":"A chunk offset is decoded from attacker-controlled trailer data; if this offset is malformed it can redirect later lazychunk construction."},{"step":5,"file":"blosc/frame.c","function":"frame_get_lazychunk","line":1877,"var":"offset","code":"if (frame->cframe == NULL) { ... } else { *chunk = frame->cframe + header_len + offset; }","note":"The lazychunk path uses the decoded offset to choose between a borrowed in-memory chunk pointer and a synthesized heap buffer."},{"step":6,"file":"blosc/frame.c","function":"frame_get_lazychunk","line":159,"var":"*chunk","code":"if (rc < 0) { if (needs_free) { free(*chunk); *chunk = NULL; } }","note":"On error, the cleanup logic frees only when needs_free is set, so a malformed offset/metadata combination can corrupt ownership and reach an invalid free in the lazychunk flow."}]
EOF
python3 -c 'import json; json.load(open("/workspace/candidate_trace.json")); print("trace ok")'` executed with exit code 0.
